fields.name: LongRestEntity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x330C7C0 (~esv::TimelineSystem::CreateTimeline) adds the component (bg3.exe+0x3312760, default null handle) to the timeline entity only for timeline type 6 and stores the 8 bytes at +0x100 of the creation parameters. The esv::rest::LongRestSystem reader bg3.exe+0x2BDCC00 (query LongRestComponent + SyncedTimelineControlComponent, stride 0x10) passes it to bg3.exe+0x26E9A00, which fetches eoc::rest::LongRestState of that entity.

fields.name: LastNodeCompleted
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3309150 (esv::TimelineSystem, node-completed handling, branch for timeline type 6) sets it to 1 when the completed node Guid equals the NodeId of the last entry of the synced control's Nodes (stride 0x50), otherwise to 0. Created 0. bg3.exe+0x2BDCC00 tests the byte at +8 together with LongRestState+2.

second_pass: The long-rest system's reader bg3.exe+0x2BDCC00 (called from the per-frame update of esv::rest::LongRestSystem) walks the component with stride 0x10, resolves the handle at +0 to the entity's eoc::rest::LongRestState and tests the bool at +8: both members settled on Windows.
